name: Daily Puzzle Seed
description: One puzzle a day, the same one for everybody. The seed is derived from the calendar date in a declared timezone rather than from the device clock, which is what makes a shared leaderboard mean anything and what stops a player rerolling by changing their settings. Yesterday's puzzles remain addressable so a missed day can be played without polluting today's board, and a streak is tracked because the streak is the reason the mode retains anyone. The component owns the seed and the calendar; the puzzle itself is whatever utility.logic_grid_engine generates from it.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: Timezone the daily boundary is computed in. A device-local boundary makes the shared leaderboard meaningless.

inputs.name: streakGraceDays
inputs.description: Missed days forgiven before a streak breaks.
